name: desktop-layout
notes_for_reader: This is not a set of pictures but a design spec for the Mac window. reference.html is a live mock (open it in a browser from this folder: it takes the pictures from the sibling folders of deliver/). Everything in the app is rebuilt from the same assets that are already delivered; no new images are needed.

setting.where: Settings page, section 'Оформление окна' (two cards with a small wireframe each, the selected one has a light border)
setting.apply: at once, no restart; remember between launches; when the user switches while on the Settings page, stay on Settings (sidebar: the 'Настройки' item, tabs: a 'Настройки' tab)

items: group 'Сервисы': Нейросети, Telegram, YouTube и Discord, each with its own switch at the right
sidebar.rowHeight: 7 pt padding top and bottom, font 12.5

home.content: only the mascot with the halos (one per service that is on), the title and the subtitle, and one button 'Включить всё' / 'Выключить всё'. NO service rows on Home: the switches are in the sidebar. Scale the hero about 1.25 and centre it vertically.
home.reason: the switches would duplicate the sidebar

sidebar.pages: Нейросети, Telegram, YouTube и Discord, Настройки keep the content they have now (same cards), with the page name as a title

tabs.tabBar: in the title bar after the traffic lights. Pinned 'Главная' tab with the stack of three small rings (no word). Other tabs: word and a close cross. '+' opens a menu of the pages that are not open yet. The gear at the right end opens Настройки as a tab.
tabs.ring: the header ring (../header) goes round the word of the selected tab, round the stack icon on Главная; delivered movement, see ../header/header-motion.js
tabs.home: the mascot (scale 0.8), the button, and the three service rows with switches and a 'Настроить' button that opens the page of that service as a tab (the switches are needed here because there is no sidebar)

menuBarPanel.trigger: the Nimb icon in the menu bar; the icon is the small ring of ../header (ring-back + ring-front at about 0.1 scale), dim (opacity 0.45) when nothing is on, full when at least one service is on

rows.what: title ('Всё включено' / 'Включено частично' / 'Выключено'), a line 'N из 3 работают', and a big switch for everything

switch; the second line is the name of the current DNS server with a small chevron; clicking the row opens an inline list of the DNS providers (name, speed, a check mark on the current one); choosing one switches the server (same action as choosing it on the Нейросети page) and closes the list
switch; while the proxy runs two small buttons under the row: 'Открыть в Telegram' (the 'Add proxy' window) and 'Скопировать ссылку'
switch only. The check of YouTube and Discord is NOT in the panel (it stays on its page)

menuBarPanel.note: The app already has a menu in the menu bar (StatusMenuController); this is what it should become.

notes: Black and white; colour only for the green switches and status dots. Layout code must keep the existing rules: the window draws only while it is visible and in front. The reference is a mock, the values (speeds, counters) in it are made up.
